thread:
anya: Noticed invoice preview doubling token lines when alias->fallback routing kicks in. Example: client hits `rico`, falls back to `rico-quant`, preview shows both. Anyone on call?
devon: Repro on staging. Proxy gives new req_id for fallback; metering keys on req_id so we get separate events.
maria: Quick fix idea: emit canonical_request_id + canonical_model at ingress before fallback so downstream can dedupe.
liam: Schema change ripples. Need consumer opt-in flag. Also event size increases at high QPS.
ops-eng: Alternative: aggregator-side coalescer using short fingerprint (tenant + session + prompt_prefix) within 1s window to merge events. No producer changes.
anya: Which is lower-risk for canary?
devon: Hybrid: enable aggregator coalescer behind a flag for canary traffic, sample canonical_id at edge (2%) to validate end-to-end. If metrics good, roll schema change and flip consumers.
maria: PR with sampling fields: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9301
liam: Add consumer config `accepts_canonical_id` default false. We'll flip per-tenant after validation.
ops-eng: Telemetry: emit billing.preview_dup_rate, billing.preview_delta_tokens, billing.dedupe_events_per_min. Alert if preview_dup_rate > 0.2% for 15m.
billing-bot: Created billing ticket BILL-833 to track migration and email suppression for canary cohorts.
anya: Console UX: mark previews as "Provisional (may include duplicates during rollouts)" and pause preview emails for affected cohorts. Plan: 2% -> 25% -> 100% if preview_dup_rate <0.1%.
